title: Affordable Decorating
lede: An archive of the contents of one warehouse.
body:
This site catalogues the contents of a warehouse. The warehouse was purchased at a tax sale. The previous occupant was Affordable Decorating, a design consultancy that supplied low-cost decorating to offices, motels and municipal buildings from the early 1970s until it stopped answering its telephone.

Nothing was labelled as expected. Alongside the decorative stock there were crates of commissioned work, several filing cabinets, and a great many forms. The commissioned work has no clients on record. Each piece is original. The paperwork is firm about this.

Items are catalogued in the order they are reached. Each receives an inventory number, a department and a description. Where a condition note applies, it is included. Many items have a 3D file, available to download without charge. Each file is either a scan of the item as it stands in the warehouse, or a reconstruction made from the firm's internal blueprints, in which case the item itself has not been found.

The firm's internal pages were recovered from a server in the office. They are presented in the [intranet archive](intranet:home) as found.

title: About
body:
Affordable Decorating is a fictional design consultancy. Its history is invented. Everything on this site was made by one person.

The objects, files, patterns and writing here are real. The company, the warehouse, the staff and the archive are not. No person on this site is real, and no biography here describes anyone.

Files are free to download and use. Some original works may be available to acquire. Where that is so, the item's own page gives a price and an email link to inquire. There is no shop or cart, and nothing else here asks for anything.

entries.title: Photography begins
entries.body: The first items were photographed against a plain wall, with a scale card.
